name: Earthenware
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.547

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: glazed earthenware: procedural throwing rings, glaze pooling, pinholes and crazing on a pale neutral glaze (the glaze colour is the material tint); worn through to red biscuit where the rust mask of Poly Haven rusty_metal_02 places it
known_weaknesses: procedural apart from the wear mask; dielectric glaze, no clear-coat layer
